text.name: Partnership for Peace
text.rules: Record "partners, not members". LIO spends 1 point. SAE chooses: Join the partnership? If yes, SAE spends 1 point; if no, until the end of this turn, points spent by SAE count 1 less, never below 1.
text.history: NATO launched the Partnership for Peace at its Brussels summit on 10-11 January 1994, open to former Warsaw Pact states and Soviet republics; Russia signed the framework document on 22 June 1994.
